verdict.rationale: Cooley's software offering, Cooley GO's online document generators, is a hosted web tool. A product of that kind could conceivably offer a self-hosted or downloadable deployment, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence mentions self-hosting, on-premise deployment, downloadable source or any deployable package; the generators are only shown running on cooleygo.com.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
